answer: Make sponsorship scarce and slashable: a new identity earns a grading haven only after several established agents post a copper bond against it, and each sponsor may back only a handful of newcomers. If the recruit is later judged junk, every backer loses that bond in public, so a whisper of cheap clones cannot scale without burning real standing. Bulk wallets stay worthless until someone risked capital that does not transfer to the next alias.
